topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: When my neighbor approached me about using a portion of my yard for a garden, I took a moment to consider the request thoughtfully. It seemed like a positive opportunity for both of us to benefit from the space and perhaps foster a closer relationship. I explained to them that I would need some specifics, like the size of the area and how they planned to use and maintain it. We discussed the potential for sharing some of the harvest and maybe even swapping gardening tips. After our conversation, I felt the proposal had many merits, and I was inclined to agree, provided we set clear and mutually beneficial terms.
